inputs.root_cause: Event 239 flagged the mrk-ref-resolution cluster as the one recurring, precisely-named remaining gap after dataRef/isolated-attribute/file-id work closed everything else nearby. 4 obligations (SAL-XLIFF-OBL-441E7C6F7C341B12, DA738080DC614E67, EC188D4F6DD138A0, F20C2CA429BA381B) share a 'references must resolve' rule_text whose ec/sc and dataRef halves were already closed, leaving mrk's own ref attribute confirmed genuinely unimplemented by grep.
inputs.obligation_targeted: SAL-XLIFF-OBL-441E7C6F7C341B12 (XLIFF-MODEL-001), SAL-XLIFF-OBL-DA738080DC614E67 (XLIFF-VALIDATE-001), SAL-XLIFF-OBL-EC188D4F6DD138A0 (XLIFF-PARSE-001), SAL-XLIFF-OBL-F20C2CA429BA381B (XLIFF-INLINE-001) -- all promoted partial->implemented
inputs.acceptance_evidence: 6 new tests prove: a comment-type mrk ref resolving to a same-unit note validates cleanly; an unresolvable ref, and a ref with zero notes in the unit, are each flagged; a term-type mrk's external-URI ref is never checked; a comment-type mrk with no ref at all is not checked here; the check applies independently to target content.
inputs.regression_tier: full xliff package suite (tests/python/xliff) plus 6-format regression

execution_steps: 1. Read all 4 obligations' shared missing_behavior text confirming the exact remaining scope: mrk's own ref attribute, confirmed by a prior tick's grep to have no code path anywhere reading or resolving it.

2. Read the pinned XLIFF 2.1 spec source directly (.local/format-contracts/acquired/xliff/src-xliff-001.bin) searching for every 'mrk' occurrence near 'ref' rather than guessing the mechanism from memory. Found two DISTINCT documented ref usages: type='term' (section on term annotations, ref points at an arbitrary external URI like a DBpedia page) and type='comment' (section 4.7.3.1.3 Comment Annotation, ref MUST point at a <note> element within the same enclosing <unit>, worked example using fragment form ref="#n=n1").

3. Confirmed the term-type usage has no same-document resolution requirement stated anywhere in the spec -- deliberately scoped the new check to type='comment' only, to avoid inventing a constraint the spec never states for type='term'.

4. Probed the model directly before writing any code: confirmed mrk's type/ref attributes are stored generically in InlineElement.attributes (no special modeling needed), and Unit.notes/Note.id already exist and are sufficient to resolve against.

5. Added _MRK_COMMENT_REF_NOTE_ID (a regex extracting the trailing 'n=<id>' segment from a ref value, tolerant of a longer qualified path even though the spec's own same-unit case only needs the short form) and _mrk_comment_ref_diagnostics() to validator.py, reusing the exact same per-unit qname-agnostic walking pattern already proven for _data_ref_diagnostics -- added 'import re' since the module had none before.
6. Wired the new function into validate() at the same per-unit call site as _data_ref_diagnostics.

7. Probed directly before writing formal tests: a valid same-unit comment ref produced no mrk diagnostic; an unresolvable ref and a ref with zero notes in the unit both correctly fired xliff.mrk.comment.ref.unresolved; a term-type mrk with an external URI produced no diagnostic; a comment-type mrk with no ref at all produced no diagnostic. All 5 correct on the first attempt.

8. Ran the full pre-existing xliff suite (455 tests, zero new fixtures) against the new check to look for false positives before writing a single new test -- all 455 passed unchanged, confirming zero pre-existing fixture used a comment-type mrk with an unresolvable ref.
9. Wrote 6 formal tests in a new file (test_obligation_mrk_comment_ref_resolution.py), all passing on the first attempt.

10. Ran ruff (clean), the full xliff suite (461 passed, was 455, +6), and the full 6-format regression (3408 passed, was 3402, +6; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.

11. Ran skills-first governance: resolve -> add-python-api (COMPOSE_EXISTING_SKILLS), manifest create --write (sfx-8cfc5335d580dc6b, confirmed as the actually-persisted manifest via ls -t .local/skills-first/manifests/), hand-written receipt YAML, closeout --close -> CLOSE_OK.

12. Promoted all 4 obligations to implemented: this was the final remaining named gap in their shared rule_text's 'references must resolve' clause -- ec/sc pairing, dataRef, and now mrk's own ref are all directly proven.

.venv/Scripts/pytest tests/python/ipynb tests/python/ora tests/python/nrrd tests/python/xliff tests/python/safetensors tests/python/ubl -q -- 3408 passed, 2 skipped, 4 preexisting unrelated safetensors interop failures, was 3402 passed
